benchmark.scope: shared-power scheduling on a discrete grid

config.milp: SciPy/HiGHS, native assignment/power/occupancy constraints, zero MIP relative gap

benchmark.timing_policy: Process CPU time and elapsed wall time per workflow, including candidate generation, formulation, solving/training/sampling, and independent validation. Interpreter/library imports and exact-reference computation are excluded. CPU time sums process threads and can exceed wall time. Aer measurements are simulation runtime, not QPU runtime. No quantum hardware was used.
benchmark.thread_policy: Existing Aer solver uses one thread; HiGHS uses its defaults. No CPU affinity or resource isolation is enforced.
benchmark.sample_policy: QAOA and structured random use the same final sample count, not equal computational work. MILP is not a sampler. Counts are stored in Qiskit displayed bit order (highest qubit first).
